items.title: From Penny Stock to Takeover Target: Who Will Snap Up QuantumScape?
items.summary: QuantumScape holds solid-state battery IP that every major automaker quietly covets, yet its stock has lost more than half its value in a year. Five potential acquirers have the cash, the motive, and a reason to move before someone else does.

items.title: Why Is GLW Stock Falling Today?
items.summary: Corning’s third-quarter guidance fell short of Wall Street expectations, with the company’s softer near-term outlook weighing on the stock ahead of the opening bell on Tuesday.

items.title: Corning Shares Slide Despite Second-Quarter Earnings Beat as Guidance Disappoints
items.summary: Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings on Tuesday, but investors focused on weaker-than-anticipated guidance for the third quarter, sending the specialty glass and materials manufacturer’s shares down 11. 2%.

items.title: Corning (GLW) Surpasses Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Corning (GLW) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.63% and +2.94%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Corning (NYSE:GLW) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates, Stock Drops 16.1%
items.summary: Glass and electronic component manufacturer Corning (NYSE:GLW) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 11.4% year on year to $4.51 billion. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $4.95 billion underwhelmed, coming in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.78 per share was 3.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Corning Issues Lighter Revenue Outlook After Strong AI-Driven Results
items.summary: Corning issued lighter-than-expected third-quarter sales guidance, overshadowing a better-than-expected second quarter that was driven by artificial-intelligence demand.
